name: service-area-list
title: Service area list
description: The places you work, as links to local pages in balanced columns grouped by region, with a radius note and an Other places line.
docs: Places are sorted for you: alphabetically, or largest first when places carry a priority (any number, a population works). A place without an href is plain text, so no link goes nowhere. radius is two parts, label and from, joined into one sentence. The Other places line shows when contactHref is set; labels changes its words. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the place links.
